extensionDescription.message: Let Remote AI browse web pages, find information, and work with websites for you. You can pause it at any time.

popupSubtitle.message: Manage the connection and website access

allowAllSitesHint.message: When on, websites do not need to be confirmed one by one. When off, you can allow websites individually.

popupFooterHint.message: Only websites you allow are controlled. You can pause control or revoke access at any time.

chatLoadingSlow.message: This is taking longer than usual. Reload the chat or open it in a new tab.

approvalDescription.message: Remote AI will be able to view this website and click, type, and take screenshots when you ask.

approvalRequestEnded.message: This request has ended. You can close this window.

enableInRemoteAi.message: First enable the browser assistant in Remote AI, then click Reconnect.

assistantUpdating.message: The browser assistant is updating. Try again later.

browserActionFailed.message: Could not complete the browser action. Try again.

closedTabCleanupFailed.message: Could not clear the record of a closed tab.

sidePanelEnableFailed.message: Could not enable the side panel. Reload the browser assistant.

tabGroupRenameFailed.message: Could not update tab group names.

regularPagesOnly.message: Only regular web pages are allowed. Browser settings and URLs with a username or password cannot be used.

invalidInputText.message: The input text is too long or invalid.

readPageBeforeAction.message: Read the page first, then choose what to act on.

readPageBeforeDrag.message: Read the page first, then choose where to drag.

invalidFinishTargets.message: Select the tabs or workers used in this task.

invalidLogLimit.message: The number of log entries must be a whole number from 1 to 200.

invalidLogSince.message: Select a valid log start time.

invalidLogText.message: Enter a log keyword of 1 to 500 characters.

workerHasNoPageLogs.message: Workers have no page logs. Select another log source.

invalidClickPosition.message: Invalid click position. Read the page again or take a new screenshot.

workerChanged.message: This worker has changed. Read the logs again.

tooManyLogFrames.message: The page has too many frames. Reduce the embedded pages and try again.

pageChangedReadLogs.message: The page has changed. Read the logs again.

workerSiteUnknown.message: Could not determine which website this worker belongs to. List the available workers again.

workerStopped.message: This worker has stopped. List the available workers again.

workerConnectFailed.message: Could not connect to this worker. Close its developer tools and try again.

elementNotVisible.message: This element is not visible right now. Read the page again.

dragAcrossFrames.message: Drag within a single page frame.

organizeNewTabsFailed.message: Could not organize the newly opened pages. Check them and try again.

groupTabsFailed.message: Could not group the tabs. Check the newly opened tabs and try again.

openGroupedTabFailed.message: Could not open the grouped tab. Try again.

screenshotTooLarge.message: The screenshot is too large. Make the browser window smaller and try again.

noHistoryEntry.message: There is no page in history to go to.

waitTimedOut.message: Timed out. The expected content has not appeared on the page.

frameChanged.message: The page frame has changed. Read the page again.

referenceExpired.message: This page reference has expired. Read the page again.

pageNavigated.message: The page has navigated away. Read the page again.

tabConnectFailed.message: Could not connect to this tab. Close its developer tools or other browser automation tools and try again.

elementActionFailed.message: The page content has changed, or this element cannot perform this action. Read the page again.

tooManyFrames.message: The page has too many frames. Close unrelated content and try again.

frameConnectionChanged.message: The page frame connection has changed. Read the page again.

allowSiteInChrome.message: Allow the browser assistant to access this website in Chrome's extension settings.

browserConnectionEnded.message: The browser connection has ended. Try the action again.

controlPaused.message: Browser control is paused. Resume it in the browser assistant.

siteAccessNotGrantedInChrome.message: Website access was not granted. Confirm it in Chrome and try again.

accessRequestEnded.message: This request has ended. Try the action again.
